title: Flocking with Multiple Types: Competition, Fluid Limits and Traveling Waves
summary: We study a class of interacting particle systems on $\mathbb{R}$ with two types. Particles evolve by independent jumps sampled from a fixed distribution, with type-dependent jump rates $v_+$, $v_-$ and stochastic type switching driven by non-local order-based interactions. The switching rates depend on the empirical distribution through the proportion of opposite-type particles located ahead, leading to a nonlinear and discontinuous dependence on the empirical measure outside the standard Lipschitz McKean-Vlasov framework.
